notes.title: eSail optional Version 3 Beta
notes.notes:
eSail V3 BETA (3.0.x) is an exciting new update that brings new features to the eSail community.  As always, our updates are free for all eSail users. V3 is based on Unity 6 which itself is in Beta.  As well as adding new features, a lot of work has been done on compatibility with Unity 6. Although this doesn't add anything for users short term, it means we are on the right platform going forward, which should speed up development.

NOTE 1: Before running the Beta backup your data folder. See the Technical Support discussion for this folder's location.
NOTE 2: Challenges are excluded from the beta. This is because the boat handling has changed slightly. We will probably have new leaderboards once V3 is fully released.
NOTE 3:  All new text is in English only. Translations will be added once the Beta is completed.  At that stage will will also add speech in languages as required.
NOTE 4:  Users on the beta will be in a different 'world' to those on V2.

NEW FEATURES

 Better graphics.  All terrain textures have been improved. There is also now more use of the 'Detailed World' setting which adds more objects including rocks, trees, roads and harbour details. Even the seaweed has been replaced with something a bit more appealing (although remember performance considerations do limit the detail!)  Many buildings have been given window lights. This can help when night sailing.
 Wind variability (Live Sailing).  Now the wind responds to the shape of nearby land causing wind shifts. Anabatic and katabatic breezes cause patches on the water surface which the observant sailor can use to maximise speed!  For more information see https://www.esailyachtsimulator.com/the-world-of-esail/wind/
 New 'Trade Islands' added.  These islands are slightly tidal so you have to be aware of tidal heights. There are published tide tables for the islands. 
 New chart for the Trade Islands.  This is available once you have collected all the POIs for Navaronne etc. This level is now classified as 'Atlantic Explorer'.  The new level for the Trade Islands is 'Tidal Explorer'.
 Reference section and notebook.  On the menu there is a new button for 'Reference'.  Here you can look up any term or function featured in eSail.  There is also a simple notebook for making - you guessed it - notes.
 Boat detailing.  We have started an ongoing process of adding more graphical detail to the boat. This includes a new masthead wind indicator.
 Reciprocal button on the chart plotter. This enables you to quickly read a line from the opposite bearing.
 The depth sounder now reads depth taking into account wave and tide height.
 Hands and wheel centre adjustable brightness.
 Each chart now is saved with zoom and position.
 Added an ‘all lines delete’ button to charts.
 Run in Background option. See the first section of Settings.
 Added Settings to modify keyboard steering and throttle.
 Plan view - you can now plot the courses of boats, with boat names now visible on the plan. So before racing this can be turned on. In the event of possible foul play, take a screenshot so that we can see how the action has unfolded.  Click on the chart plotter behind the compass, then the orange button.
 Glance view added to Smart Button. Drag left or right on the button so see at 90 degrees. See the tooltip for keyboard shortcuts.


eSail Pro


 Fixed bug where autopilot was always setting to apparent wind (in Wind Mode).
 Tidal Curve tool. This interactive tool can be found in the chart drawer.
 Tidal heights tutorials.
 Added tack mode to autopilot. While using the autopilot hit the button to steer the boat onto the opposite tack.


Thank you for your suggestions which have been incorporated here.  Please add feedback to the new V3 discussion.  All feedback is very welcome!


To swap to the V3 Beta:

First back up your data!

1. Right click on eSail in your Steam client.

2. On the drop down menu click 'Properties'

3. Click on the BETAS tab.

4. Select 'eSail_V3' branch.  The password is:  eSailEmerald

notes.title: New eSail Update 2.4.08
notes.notes:
This new update is designed to help novice sailors, as well as fix a few bugs.

1. Added a Points of Sail diagram.  This can be accessed from the 'Adjusting the Mainsail' tutorial.  (In V3 all learning resources will be accessible from a central location.)

2. Previously it was easy to accidentally click on the sail bag in the cabin and deploy the asymmetric without even knowing it. So we have now added a confirmation alert.

3. We have added a note in first tutorial about how the tutorials are saved and how to access other tutorials / challenges.

4. We have modified the starting boat positions of the basic tutorials to help novice sailors avoid crashing into the training buoys or land.

5. Fixed bug - when changing line (radial left) hands hotspot was disappearing.

6. Fixed bug - where medals would appear on changing the time between local/UTC on the Multiplayer Challenges screen.

7. Fixed bug - page 3737 wave file (English only) as this referred to travellers not being in eSail which is no longer the case.

8. Changed visibility of boat name on stern so that it can be seen at a greater distance. 

9. Improvement to multiplayer to avoid to avoid boats appearing on top of one another.

10. German language fixes. Thank you to Tjabo for pointing these out!

11. Improvements in mooring to reduce errors with disappearing/misaligned mooring lines. Thank you Peter for all your testing of these issues.

12. Fixed bug where dragging on screen to look around or orbit could lock up.

To force an update, sign out of Steam (user your user top right), then sign back in again.  Otherwise Steam will automatically update your eSail in due course.

notes.title: Update 2.4.03f1
notes.notes: This small update fixes a problem with the timings of buoy and land lights.  Thank you to raskil2000 for pointing this out.  We have checked all lights but it is still possible we may have missed something, so any positive or negative reports would be much appreciated.

notes.title: Update 2.3.211
notes.notes:
This update has a number of small fixes and improvements, as well as additional languages for eSail Pro. A huge thank you to all our community translators!


 Added missing throttle handle
 Better debugging when leaving a challenge
 Added French, German, Spanish, Greek, Italian, Dutch languages for eSail Pro.  
 Changed hand compass scale to make it larger
 Binoc and hand compass icons in drawer. Moved tooltip down as was fighting cursor on certain resolution/scaling combinations
 Fixed bug where in central mooring sometimes crew could not pull line
 Fixed bug where boat heading was not being restored in Sandbox
 Now saving ‘wind’ mode and ‘true wind’ setting. Also made sure that Autopilot settings were applied on restoring

notes.title: Update 2.3.207
notes.notes:
This update has a number of small bug fixes and improvements. Thank you to users for reporting these and helping replicate these issues.


 Fixed bug where game boat's engines were not sounding
 Fixed bug where anchoring was not working in Mooring Sandbox
 Improved physics fighting between mooring lines with stern-to mooring
 Anchoring - improved holding especially on sloping or slimy sea bed
 Jib now should unfurl easier if on the leeward side.
 Yaw now made to bring the stern quarter to the wind (blows the bow away from direction of wind)
 Added Change Password text to button on Edit User Screen
 Quick Start now says “(Advanced Users)”
 Edit User screen now has shortcut to force Registration Completed.
 Alert added when an Add-on is installed referring user to new tutorials.
 Alert added when adding mooring lines before fenders.
 Added a check to stop fenders being rigged after mooring lines.
 Changed eSail Pro tutorial wording to refer to new Etincelle pump and tank being quarter full on new boat.
 Added new Etincelle fuel pump.
 New boats now get quarter tank of fuel.
 Made all dashboard mode buttons pointer click (not pointer down).  This might prevent bug where cannot change mode.
 Bug fixes for setting sleeve colors and winches while doing central mooring

notes.title: Update 2.3.204
notes.notes: This small update just adds the capability to add the eSail Pro DLC coming soon.

notes.title: eSail Update 2.3.102f2
notes.notes:
This small update has a new method to try to prevent drop-outs in multiplayer.  We have also increased the screen size for keyboard shortcuts to enable longer descriptions in German and Italian.

Note that this multiplayer update is not compatible with older versions, so it is possible that boats may not be visible while users update.

Any feedback would be very much appreciated!

notes.title: New eSail Update 2.3.05
notes.notes:
This new version brings you:

1. A fix to stop out of range data causing issues for all users in multiplayer mode.

2. A new steam ship (The Aurora) is running between Water Head Islands and Port Fogarty in Southern Shearwater Island. As this is a lot of water to cover when testing any sightings (or even better screenshots) would be much appreciated.

3. An ensign flag is now on the backstay. This helps to give an indication of wind direction. You can change the size and position of flag in Settings. (Or turn it off by making size zero).

4. You can now change the sleeve colours of both crew members in Settings.

5. On the chart you can now add extra lines. Also you can set the angle of the plotter (bottom left). This means at last you can properly plot your position using the hand compass.

notes.title: New eSail update 2.1.116
notes.notes:
This update has a number of small improvements:

- Performance improvement in multiplayer due to fewer calls to the server
- Differentiation of crew by colouring the sleeves (this will be customisable in the next release)
- Keyboard shortcuts to enable more precise control of crew. To move focus to a specific winch use Control 1, Control 2 etc. This is the Control key as specified in the Keyboard Commands. Once you have the focus on a winch you can choose which crew member to send there. Use Control Enter for the Green Crew and LeftAlt Enter for the White Crew. (Control Enter and Command Enter on Mac)
- Bug fix to allow easier access to game if not signing up to multiplayer.
- Bug fix to correctly focus MOB panels

notes.title: New eSail update 2.1.114
notes.notes:
This new update fixes a number of small issues:

1) When jumping to race start in eSail multiplyaer racing, sometimes you could end up on the rocks at the end of the race start line. eSail now jumps you close to the middle of the start line.

2) We now prevent game restarts in time trials as well as races.  This helps avoid reconnection errors. We now also have a 15 minutes max pause for time trials.

3) Time trials can now be run in Multiplayer +12h. This should make it easier to avoid playing at night!

notes.title: Update 2.1.112
notes.notes:
This update has a number of small fixes:
1) Change to the position of coordinates on the pencil. This is to stop an issue where at certain resolution/interface scaling combinations it was impossible to mark a cross with the pencil.
2) A fix to stop the boat position being written into the wrong place (the location of the eSail software). This could result in a wrong start position if you reset Live Sailing.
3) Fixed park benches floating in the sea!

notes.title: Update 2.1.109
notes.notes: Fixes to anchoring challenges.

notes.title: Update 2.1.108f1
notes.notes:
This small patch fixes the following issues:
1) Boat lines being constantly reset during Live Sailing challenges
2) During boat jump in Live Sailing Challenges, there would be problems if you were anchored or moored.  Jumping is now prevented in these situations.

Also jumping is now allowed in all challenges (passages and races) provided you are within 5 miles of the start.

notes.title: eSail Update 2.1.108
notes.notes:
This new update includes:

  Changed multiplayer challenges so that you can jump to the start if you are within 5 nautical miles distance. This means that if you set up a user/boat in each of the main sailing areas you can now very quickly get to any challenge. 
 Now users can publish challenges.  To do so please contact support to request 'Content Creator' status. A limited number of these will be allowed short term.
 Fixes to improve winch handling and avoid issues when using keys during sailing and mooring
 Extra debugging to diagnose occasional UI lock ups. (In case of a UI lock up please exit eSail and send us the log files).
 Improvements to VHF chat to avoid accidentally typing (while holding a steering key down for instance).
  Changes to autosave so it is all kept locally.  Although Live Sailing saves are kept on local machines, the autosave positions were being shared using Steam Cloud save. This was causing some issues for users with multiple machines.
  Added confirm email field.
  Fix to stop anchor attaching to terrain during a collision.


Thank you to everyone who provided their feedback on the beta!

notes.title: eSail Update 2.1.1
notes.notes:
This update has a number of small enhancements including improvements to multiplayer races.


 There is now a 15 minute timeout when you are in a race. This means if you pause or go to the menus for longer than this time you will be removed from the race and the multiplayer 'world'.  You may still be able to re-enter but only by going to the main multiplayer Challenges menu.  This change is to stop users accidentally blocking others from entering.
  We expect to be able to allow more users into races now, so hopefully re-entering a race after a timeout should not be a problem in most cases.
   Settings/Enable Controller is now OFF by default.  This will only affect new users.
   Fixed an issue where using key controls 1-4 could cause a lock up when crew moving between winches.
   Fixed missing characters on the navigation lights panel. (Turkish).
   Added missing speech files in MOB Power.
   Added Local Time option to challenges screen.
   Enabled eSail to work when there is no internet connection (as was the case in V1).
   Fixed Settings issues when pausing.
   Improved sail shapes of other players' boats.


Thank you to everyone who helped with reporting and fixing these bugs!

notes.title: Update 2.1.001
notes.notes:
2.1.001
Fixed alert where after showing the racing rules the text was squashed on a subsequent alert.
Fixed problem with Advanced Tutorials not showing when Man Overboard is not installed. 
Changed multiplayer so that all players are in the 2 main multiplayer modes/worlds, including players in challenges. This is subject change - in times of high demand challenges may be moved to separate worlds.

notes.title: 2.0.957 Development Version
notes.notes:
2.0.957 is the latest open 'Development' version. Before using this make sure you back up your data folder.   

NOTE: this version has wind shadowing so you can use this tactically in races to slow other boats  !(multiplayer)

You can also now add your own races to share with friends using an Access Code.

Windows: C:\Users\Your name\AppData\LocalLow\VRActive\eSail
NOTE: The AppData folder may be hidden in Windows. To unhide check the 'Hidden items' box under View in Windows Explorer. 

MacOS: Library/Application Support/VR Active/eSail
OR  Library/Application Support/unity.VRActive.eSail

This version has multiplayer challenges.  At the moment you can also create your own courses. However you will not be able to make challenges out of these courses (yet). We will just see how things go before starting to make that available.

It is possible that challenges and leaderboard data might be removed, but we will try to avoid this now.

We have also added an asymmetric sail.  See the new tutorial under Quick Start/Advanced.

To swap to the Development version:

1. Right click on eSail in your Steam client.

2.  On the drop down menu click 'Properties'

3. Click on the BETAS tab.

4. Select the Development beta from the drop down list. 

Please provide your feedback in the Development Forum.

NOTES:

 Languages are still a work in progress. There may be gaps in any language apart from English which should be complete.
 All multiplayer challenges should be in UTC.  Please do not use UTC+12 when running multiplayer challenges. This will come later. 
 You will need to register by editing your main user inside eSail.  NOTE: your additional users can also be registered at the moment (using different email addresses) but these users may be removed later.

notes.title: Update 1.7.44
notes.notes:
This minor update fixes these problems:

1. NPC boat engines fixed missing sound
2. Changed position of bow spray on large ship
3. Fixed issue where description of steering controls was reversed
4. Changed 'Controller enabled' to off in Settings as this seems to be the major cause of any steering issues.

notes.title: eSail 1.7.42 - minor update
notes.notes:
This small update fixes these issues:

1) Steering. Some users have experienced steering problems, normally when returning to eSail after a break. We have addressed at least one cause of this, but it is very hard to test as the issue is so infrequent. Please let us know if you experience this problem.

2) We have improved the restored state of the reefed sails. This includes problems with the sail material and also telltales which were left hanging in the air.

3) Fixed a bug where Man Overboard would leave a long elastic line joining the MOB to the boat.

4) Fixed terrain textures in the Northern Islands. The terrain had far too much contrast and is more balanced now.

5) We have added a link to the description of the 'Nature Research Station'.  This link points to some satellite imagery which may make it (slightly!) easier to navigate in and out of the marshes.

notes.title: eSail Sailing Simulator German version released
notes.notes:
The eSail German version is here at last!  After several months of work by 7 translators and reviewers eSail is now much more accessible to German speakers.  As well as translating the main tutorials, challenges and the interface we have also used Google speech synthesis, so you don't need to read as you are sailing - our virtual narrator will talk to you.

Thank you to all the fantastic contributors who took part in this project.

eSail is a great way of improving your sailing skills. It has numerous tutorials, sailing, mooring and anchoring modes, sailing challenges, races, Live Sailing mode, ‘Learn yachting with eSail’ training course and more.

Use eSail to practise your skills before skippering or crewing a real world boat. Or keep your sailing in the virtual world – it’s up to you!

German Flag Vectors by Vecteezy

notes.title: NEW eSail Version 1.7 - Russian and French
notes.notes:
eSail v1.7 now has French and Russian language support provided by the eSail community. Adding localisation has been a big task and at the same time we have upgraded the underlying Unity engine which will bring future benefits.  There are also a number of other minor improvements and changes:

 New binoculars to help with navigation
 Mainsail boom now moves more realistically when mainsheet is slack
 Improved the look of sail cloth so it responds better to lighting
 Weather forecasts now also have text in a new comms panel, helping when wind and wave sounds might make it difficult to hear
 Telltales are brighter
 Marine life scaled down


Thank you to the amazing community translators who have made this release possible. 

Flag Vectors by Vecteezy.

notes.title: eSail Update 1.5.39
notes.notes:
eSail Update 1.5.39 has 2 new features and fixes a few small issues.

1) There is now a hand compass. See the yellow button near the main compass on the dashboard.

2) You can now pin alerts. These are the little pop up windows. We will be using these more as things get more advanced, so this will make it easier to refer back to the pop up information. At the moment the pins only last during a tutorial or challenge.

3) Fixes a missing 'close up' window on the course plotter in the charting module, making it hard to see the numbers on the protractor.

4) Stops points being deducted on challenges when fenders hit the jetty.

5) Further work has been done to avoid screen dragging while dragging on the throttle.

Thank you to all eSailors and beta testers for your feedback!

notes.title: Update 1.5.31 - Anchoring
notes.notes:
This version has been released to fix or improve anchoring issues in eSail.

These issues should now have been fixed:

1) The anchor was tending to slide along the sea bed (except when the chain was hidden).

2) When the chain was hidden it tended to break on retraction. This should be improved but that doesn't mean its impossible to break the simulation!

3) Live Sailing saving of anchor / chain sometimes caused the anchor/chain to vanish.

4) If you motored with the anchor compartment open, the anchor could fly off. Now the top chain links and anchor are locked when not being extended/retracted. (We have also added some notes to the anchoring tutorial about being careful about speed and steering to avoid breaking the simulation - as in real life you would want to avoid breaking the windless!)

5) Weird anchor behaviour - floating/ not digging in etc.

6) Anchor sliding down hill - see above. It should now lock to a slope when not being pulled or when chain is extending. It will still slide when being pulled.

7) When swapping between users (from inside eSail) sometimes Live Sailing got confused and saved the wrong location.

8) Some physics changes have been to improve chain stability.

Thank you for all our testers and beta testers for your feedback.

notes.title: Service Update - Anchoring
notes.notes:
We are experiencing some problems with anchoring at the moment, which can affect the anchoring tutorial and all anchoring situations.  

This issue affects anchoring when using the full chain. In this mode the anchor is not holding properly on the sea floor. As a short term fix, go to Settings and hide the anchor chain. This will make sure that the anchor works properly, but you will not be able to see the chain underwater.

This should be sorted out in an update due by 7th Sept.

notes.title: Update 1.5.19
notes.notes:
This small update fixes the grey appearance of the Northern Islands.  Contrary to how it might appear, this was not a layer of volcano ash, it was a bug! 

It should also fix the problem of anchored boats sometimes appearing in the wrong places.

Log out of your Steam client then back in to force the update. 

Thank you to everyone for your ongoing input with issues and suggestions.

notes.title: NEW Version 1.5 with added sailing areas (and a volcano!)
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce a new version of eSail with some great new features. NOTE: This new version requires DirectX 11.  

New Sailing Areas. Now Master Explorers have access to newly charted islands to the North of Shearwater. The islands include 'Navarone' which is dominated by a huge active volcano - Mt. Mallory. To become a Master Explorer you need to collect all 13 level 1 POIs (Points of Interest).

NEW POIs. There are 9 new 'Points of Interest' for you to find including the beautiful double Golden Angel Falls and a Seismic Monitoring Station.

New Chart B2 - Shearwater to Navarone. This is a new small scale chart from the Shearwater Coast Guard covering the whole North Shearwater area. We may also add larger scale charts depending on user feedback. You can find the chart in a new drawer under the chart table (available to Master Explorers only).

There are also numerous small fixes and changes which will be documented on the eSail website support page. One worth noting is that we have changed the default zoom direction (mouse scroll). You can change this in Settings.

Once you start using the new version you will be able to see your POI ranking here: https://steamcommunity.com/stats/794860/leaderboards/3639942

If you have any problems running the new version please contact us via https://www.esailyachtsimulator.com/support/ or the Technical Support forum.

Thank you to all our testers and beta testers for your extremely valuable feedback!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
eSail has now been updated to Version 1.4.2.  This update has a minor fix to prevent reefing lines becoming jammed. 

Meanwhile work on opening up new sailing areas to the North of Shearwater Island is progressing well and we should start testing next week. Internal testing and Beta testing will take several weeks and of course Beta testers will be the first to get the new POIs!

notes.title: New Beta 1.4.2 - minor update (Reefing)
notes.notes:
This new update has been created to improve reefing performance. In the current release it can be difficult to get the mainsail tight when it is being held down by the reefing lines, which can cause problems with the Reefing tutorial in particular.

I would very much appreciate feedback - please report any issues or confirm the improvement (hopefully!)   

Thank you to steveelliott4646 for reporting the issue.

P.S. If you have a moment please visit this video by Gregory Ball - a fellow eSailor who has created this beautiful atmospheric music and video of  Dawn at Shearwater Bay

notes.title: eSail Full Release
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that today we have taken eSail out of Early Access and published it as a full release.  I would like to thank everyone who has contributed with their feedback and ideas to get us to this point.

So what now?  Well the good news is the development does not stop here. We have lots more planned with a new sailing area coming next. That will be followed by some exciting new sailing features coming in the second half of the year.

We look forward to the next chapter in the eSail story!

notes.title: New eSail Sailing Simulator Update 1.4.x
notes.notes:
Today we have released a new version with several new features. If you do not get the update then please log out of your Steam client, then back in.

1) Better ropes (sailing control lines). Available on the highest quality level. We also have kept the older lines for lower quality levels. Getting both working smoothly has been quite fiddly!

2) Improved boat detailing - mainly pulleys and nav lights. Again this is on the highest quality.

3) Added 'Detailed water' (Settings) this gives you a bow wave and water with more detail and less tiling.

4) Added new 'Boat views' showing the boat from 4 directions. There is a little diamond button near the SmartView button so you can quickly toggle between them. 

5) Added keyboard controls for views including new BoatViews.

6) Zoom speed setting. This changes speed when using keyboard and mouse scroll.

7) Volume settings for collisions, narration etc.

8) Numerous bug fixes, especially improved AutoSail to make it more consistent.

notes.title: New eSail Update 1.3.45!
notes.notes:
Today we have released a new version with several new features. Please do try out this version (available on the beta branch) and let us have your feedback in the Beta forum. 

1) Better ropes (sailing control lines). Available on the highest quality level. We also have kept the older lines for lower quality levels.  Getting both working smoothly has been quite fiddly!

2) Improved boat detailing - mainly pulleys and nav lights. Again this is on the highest quality.

3) Added 'Detailed water' (Settings) this gives you a bow wave and water with more detail and less tiling.

4) Added new 'Boat views' showing the boat from 4 directions.  There is a little diamond button near the SmartView button so you can quickly toggle between them. 

5) Added keyboard controls for views including new BoatViews.

6) Zoom speed setting. This changes speed when using keyboard and mouse scroll.

7) Volume settings for collisions, narration etc.

8) Numerous bug fixes, especially tried to improve AutoSail and make it more consistent.

To get the Beta:

1) In your Steam client, right click on eSail Sailing Simulator (in the list on the left). Or control click in Mac.

2) A list of options should appear. Click on 'Properties' at the bottom of the list.

3) Click on the 'BETAS' tab and select 'beta -'  from the dropdown list.

4) That will download the Windows or Mac Beta as appropriate.

notes.title: Update 1.3.3_b
notes.notes: This update has now been made live.  It features a performance update which will help some Windows users and a new 'Add User' screen.

notes.title: New beta - update 1.3.3_b
notes.notes:
This new Windows only update has improved graphics performance (for some machines) and a slight modification to the 'add user' screen. To try the Beta:

1) In your Steam client, right click on eSail Sailing Simulator (in the list on the left). Or control click in Mac.

2) A list of options should appear. Click on 'Properties' at the bottom of the list.

3) Click on the 'BETAS' tab and select 'beta -'  from the dropdown list.

4) That will download the Windows Beta as appropriate. Mac version is unchanged.

Please report any issues or thoughts in 'eSail Beta' discussion group.

notes.title: New version of eSail for Windows and Mac
notes.notes:
Today we have released a new version of eSail Sailing Simulator with new trim controls and 2 new tutorials.  There is also a new race - the East Shearwater Drag Race.

A full list of changes can be found here: 
 https://www.esailyachtsimulator.com/support	


eSail v1.3 includes a voice over for the Sail Depth and Sail Trim tutorials by the fantastic Hannah White who in 2015 became the Guinness World Records holder for the fastest crossing of the English Channel in a single-handed dinghy by doing so in 3 hours, 44 minutes and 39 seconds. 

NOTE:  Thank you to all Beta testers. The Beta challenge have been removed from leaderboards but are still saved on your local machines.

The Mac version is performing well. We have noticed that the mouse scroll is rather fast. In the next update we will give more options to customise all your controls, so this will be improved then.

notes.title: eSail Sailing Simulator Version 1.2.1 Released
notes.notes:
This new version includes over 30 enhancements and bug fixes including:

* Feedback now links straight to Steam forums.

* IMPORTANT: We have changed how Settings/Day length works. Now the user’s day length is only used in Live Sailing and Locations. This to avoid time being manipulated in to get better scores in challenges.

* Added coordinate display to pencil in Chart. (Switched on bottom right). This is because it can be difficult to read the scale even for the experienced navigator. 

* Settings screen now accessible from first page.

* Improved quality (less flickering) as you move away from centre of the world.

* Now the Autosail panel rolls up with tablet.

* Stopped camera knock back after menu screens. 

* Fixed fender problem when fenders stack up in middle of boat.

* Change Sailing character behaviour so both can work at once.

For a full list go the the Support page at https://www.esailyachtsimulator.com

Thank you to all the community helpers for your feedback on the Betas.

notes.title: Update 1.2.08
notes.notes:
A minor update has been released today:

1)  Minor bug fixes relating to controller input.

2)  Adds keyboard support for Undo and Cross Crew.

3)  You can now turn off controller input so that you can map your controller to keys using your own software.

Next release:

A more comprehensive update is now in testing. This will help with the flicker problem you may get when you move to outlying islands. Also, hopefully it will finally solve the fenders getting stuck issue. We are just getting to grips with jib farleads too, so I expect these will included (TBC).

notes.title: Update 1.2.07
notes.notes: This new update improves controller support and has a number of minor bug fixes. In addition you can now reset your boat so that sails are down, mooring lines and fenders are stowed etc. (see Menu/Settings).
